description: This file defines an abstract attribute class used as a base for all placement filter marker attributes within the Orleans framework. It includes a property for the placement filter strategy and a method to populate grain properties based on this strategy.

classes.name: PlacementFilterAttribute
classes.description: An abstract attribute class that serves as a base for all placement filter marker attributes in Orleans. It encapsulates a placement filter strategy and provides a method to populate grain properties using this strategy.

methods.name: PlacementFilterAttribute(PlacementFilterStrategy placement)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the placement filter strategy, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: Populate(IServiceProvider services, Type grainClass, GrainType grainType, Dictionary<string, string> properties)
methods.description: Populates grain properties using the placement filter strategy.
